material.acceptance_criteria: mod-host Cmd::Spawn carries the mod-world unit index or reports it on spawn; room.rs fills a mod-to-room map at spawn and refuses+logs unmapped order/damage/buff ids; CI mod-reach job proves spawn-then-order moves the served unit.
material.description: Remote main cb054d35. room.rs apply_mod_commands (lines 243-269) receives mod_host::Cmd, and Cmd::Spawn { index, x, y } (mod-host/src/lib.rs:67) carries the catalog index only, not the mod-world unit id. sim.spawn returns Option<usize> (sim/src/arrays.rs:521), discarded at room.rs:248. mod-host cmd_spawn (lib.rs:709-717) pushes the same variant; mod-host apply_commands (lib.rs:1040) drains the mod's own queue via mem::take, and take_commands (lib.rs:1171) drains on_tick/timer commands, so the mod world and the room never apply the same spawn list. Without the mod-side index in the command, the room cannot key the map. Fix needs Cmd::Spawn to carry the mod world index (or mod-host to report the allocated index), which is mod-host scope and out of this row's ownership. Row gap-mod-unit-id-mapping stays pending with blocked_by this id.
material.subject: Blocked: mod unit id is not carried by the room command, so no spawn-time map can be filled inside the owned files
material.witness: Mod spawn on served room m8 at f8ab064: ev=mod_unit_bound handle=1 unit=30, /state?unit=30 returns the unit. Output /tmp/gm-probe-17/out/m8-f8ab064.txt.
material.witness_plan: ci-status on the pushed sha for the mod-reach job, once mod-host scope is granted.
